name: authortrail
description: Records the process of writing code (typed vs pasted, time spent) as a tamper-evident chain. Source code never leaves your machine.

commands.title: AuthorTrail: Export reveal file (to prove this code is my version)

authortrail.cloudSave.description: Also save a copy of the files you edit to your AuthorTrail account (stored in the database, readable by the server owner).

authortrail.pasteThreshold.description: A single insertion of at least this many characters counts as pasted (paste, autocomplete or AI suggestion).
